Q: How to add service reference in visual studio 2017 A:

In Visual Studio 2017 15.5 or later, in Solution Explorer,

  • Right mouse click the project
  • Select Add...
  • Select Connected Service
  • Select Microsoft WCF Web Services
  • Paste in the web service URL

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/additional-tools/wcf-web-service-reference-guide

Q: Android Studio 2.3 error: "Gradle sync failed: Cause: services.gradle.org" A:

I have this issue and have tried reinstalling to no avail.

What I found was useful is to look in my home directory (on Ubuntu) and open the .gradle folder and open the matching sub folder and delete the lck file and then manually download the desired gradle version (url distributionUrl value) and place the downloaded file in the folder that had the lck file.

Have attributed this problem to using usb tethering for internet..

Q: Failure code 4 while uploading file to SFTP server using Node.js A:

The second argument of SftpClient.put is a path to the target remote file, not only path to the target remote folder.

So it should be like:

return sftp.put(filePath, '/' + filename, putConfig)
